rationale: Model is linear-Gaussian, so given sigma alpha and beta are exactly Gaussian: Laplace is exact for the inner block. Only sigma is outer. Risks: log(sigma) posterior SD is about 1/sqrt(2*62) ~ 0.09, well below 1, so nlminb may stop short (convergence check may fail); start sigma=1 vs likely ~1.1-1.2 is close. Inner block is badly conditioned: x ~ 4000 uncentred, alpha and beta almost perfectly correlated, scales differ by ~4000x, so the inner Newton solver may struggle.
